3) Remote attestation call (mutual) during handoff; Redwood will provide ephemeral verification token.
4) Operator performs activation within 4 hours of verification (we note 48-hour overall constraint for safety).

Claire / Olga,

Operator onboarding checklist (highlights):
- Pre-arrival: technician identity vetting (ID + short-lived operator cert request), radio check, and sealed-bundle checksum verification.
- On arrival: open chain-of-custody form, check carrier_manifest_61129.pdf against bundle serial.
- Verification steps:
  1) Verify signature file (signed_bundle_v1.tar.gz.sig) against both KIDs (RDW-2026-11-A, RDW-2026-11-B).
  2) Run sha256sum on the payload and compare to manifest.
  3) Confirm operator certificate is in the onpremoperator CA whitelist.
- Activation: follow deploy_manifest.yaml step 7. If any mismatch, do NOT activate; escalate to Redwood + Acme SRE.

Ill host a 30-min dry run at 10:00 PST today (invite sent). Kimberly, please confirm the ephemeral verification token TTL we should use.

Priyom Das
Deployment Engineer, Redwood Inference
